title: Sessions (M4)
brief: Sessions screen of goop, opened with ctrl+x l or /resume: a filter input at the top in the composer style (placeholder 'filter sessions'); sessions grouped by day (Today, Yesterday, Last week) with title, time, message count and offers mentioned, the current one tagged ● current in muted text; a preview of the selected session (first user message, goop's last reply, offers mentioned); no key-hint line under the header: the status line with the sessions focus mode carries the list keys (↑↓ move, ↵ open, n new session, r rename, d delete, / filter, esc back) and ○ next search 09:00 │ ? help. Below the screen: filtering, rename in place as a composer (lavender edge), the irreversible delete as the M11 confirmation box (Deleted / Stays, type delete to confirm; encrypted, cannot be recovered; drawn with icons: nerd) and the toast after delete without undo, with an icons: emoji (default, Settings M6) excerpt of the delete box rows under it: neutral tiles (--background-element fill, same 2 cells and place) with ⛔ header, 💬 Session and its messages 24, 💼 Offers it mentions (dimmed, stays).

artboards.title: Full screen
artboards.tradeoff: You recognize a session from its preview without opening it; the preview column shortens the list titles and the screen hides the chat while you choose
